source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Chassis information and detail information
And Compare FRU data with ipmitool fru print to check if contect correct or not

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.

original_test_intent: Verify FRU_MID maps to the intended mid-plane/interconnect assembly and its complete FRU content agrees across BMC WebUI, exact Redfish member, read-only IPMI and the Project topology/build reference.
original_method: Establish the MID assembly's physical position and relationship links, bind its Redfish/IPMI objects, collect complete protected read-only evidence and UI detail, then normalize and compare all approved fields without log clearing or state changes.
manual_activity: The platform owner identifies which interconnect assembly `MID` denotes and supplies its topology and reference. Collection/comparison is automatable; topology/UI exceptions and verdict stay engineer-owned.
safety_requirements: Do not clear logs or modify FRU/BMC state.
Do not guess MID from a friendly name; validate relationship links and physical location.
Use trusted transport and protected credentials.
Redact asset and serial identifiers with stable correlation.
Stop on ambiguous topology or mapping without automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve the intended mid-plane in the platform topology.
Collect complete redacted Redfish/IPMI records with target metadata.
Capture WebUI detail and normalize required FRU fields.
Compare to topology/build reference and report missing/stale/encoding states.
engineer_actions: Approve MID scope and topology mapping.
Approve FRU fields, decoding, redaction and authority.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use topology-bound complete API/IPMI/UI FRU reconciliation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, schema and IPMI decoder versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor MID topology/FRU layout and Project build record.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic topology and complete secure evidence without replacing source interfaces.

modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: MID identity/topology, device map and expected fields.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: MID is platform-specific and may be confused with another interconnect or backplane.

project_override_considerations: Alternative inventory methods require exact topology binding, approval, field equivalence and uncovered original-interface coverage.
expected_evidence: Approved MID topology and physical/BMC identity
Exact API/IPMI mapping and complete raw redacted outputs
WebUI capture and Project build reference
Per-field normalized comparison plus relation links
Preserved logs, no-write proof and engineer verdict

review_improvement: Makes topology relationship evidence mandatory so a valid record from a different interconnect board cannot satisfy the ambiguous MID label.
